about_the_game:
The Hidden Passion: A Park Date with the Housewife

In this unique dating simulation game, you will embark on an unforgettable encounter with a seemingly ordinary yet secretly passionate housewife. Though her appearance may be plain, as your interactions deepen, you'll uncover the passion and desires hidden beneath her calm exterior. Your mission is to win her affection through engaging conversations at the park, unlocking various dialogue options and emotional connections along the way.

Name: Sayako

Age: 38

Occupation: Floral Art Teacher

Personality: Cheerful, simple-minded, and enjoys chatting with the opposite sex. She becomes especially enthusiastic when interacting with younger men.

Concerns: As she grows older, her husband's physical desires have decreased, while her own have become increasingly intense. She often seeks relief by using the water stream while showering and has reached a point where she craves intimacy at any time and place.

Early Access Game Content

  • 16 dialogue choices.

  • 2 event CGs.

  • 2 branching endings.

  • 2 intimate animations, including dynamic variations.

Key Features 

  • Beautiful Dynamic Visuals : Every expression and movement is meticulously crafted, bringing the character's emotions to life.

  • Japanese Voice Acting : Professional voice actors bring immersive depth to your romantic conversations with the housewife.

  • Hardware Support : This game supports mouse controls and is fully compatible with the A-GUI masturbation cup, delivering an immersive interactive experience !
